description.en: The Lane Pilot task pipeline: the PM read, the plan critique (by quality mode) with the planner's revision rounds when the critic returns the plan, the specialist risk review, the ownership base, then the code task in its own worktree with checks, code critique and merge.
description.ru: Конвейер задачи Lane Pilot: чтение PM, критика плана (по режиму качества) с кругами правки планировщиком, если критик вернул план, проверка рисков специалистом, база владения, затем кодовая задача в своём worktree с проверками, критикой кода и слиянием.

en: dispatch a code task to a writer
implement this change in the project

inputs.name: baseRef
inputs.description: The PM's baseRef, kept so a dispatch a reload interrupted starts again the same.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: What the dispatch tool answers the PM with.

outputs.name: browser_qa
outputs.description: The reply of the browser check the task's graph ran after acceptance; absent when the task carries no qa_cases and qa_url.

proof.reason: a model's summary of the read_first excerpts; it only hands context to the critics and decides nothing
proof.form: parsePmReadResult: one JSON object with a non-blank summary (a blank or unreadable answer fails the stage)

proof.check: buildExecutionPacket over the task's read_first: a malformed hint, a line window outside the file or a source over 512 KiB blocks the attempt before any paid stage; a missing or unreadable source stays advisory
the attempt and the run are stored blocked with the execution_packet_failed reason and the reply to the PM is built from it
resolveQualityMode reads the task, then the project setting: a closed enum quick, standard or full

proof.reason: a model's verdict on the plan: it never accepts a task, and in plan_critique.mode gate (the default, SMA p2_checker) its refusal stops the attempt before the writer
proof.form: parseCritique: verdict schema; a critical or high finding counts only with a file, a line and quoted evidence, and a file the critic's input names

output.name: revisable
output.description: The planner may revise the returned plan: plan_critique.revise_by planner, a refusal a plan rewrite can fix, rounds left, the PM has not taken the plan over.

proof.check: a revision is a new lane_pilot_task_contract_edition with reason planner_revision:<n>/<max> and the revised plan; objective, acceptance, owns_paths, never_touch, expected_outputs, depends_on and risk are the stored ones; a plan the critic already judged is refused (revised false)

nodes.label: Plan critique (quick: skipped by its own receipt)

proof.reason: a model's verdict on the plan: it never accepts a task, and in plan_critique.mode gate (the default, SMA p2_checker) its refusal stops the attempt before the writer
proof.form: parseCritique: verdict schema; a critical or high finding counts only with a file, a line and quoted evidence, and a file the critic's input names

proof.check: the blocked plan-critique receipt is stored with its reason and the reply to the PM is built from it

proof.reason: a model's risk opinion on the plan
proof.form: parseSpecialistResult: verdict schema; a high or critical risk counts only with a file, a line and quoted evidence, and a file the reviewer's input names

proof.check: the blocked specialist-review receipt is stored with its reason and the reply to the PM is built from it
the run gate decision and the ownership base preflight are stored in the run-gate receipt; the repository must report a readable base commit
the blocked run-gate receipt is stored with its reason and the reply to the PM is built from it
the task folder exists on the writer's machine before the writer starts
the baseline receipt stores each verification command's result on the base before any writer; a stop names its verdict
the attempt is blocked with the baseline verdict and its writer stages are closed; no writer started
enforces pauses, holds, depends_on, secrets, durable provider-breaker holds, writer.max_concurrent cap, and overlapping declared file serialisation
durable wait on lp.task.settled or wakeAt deadline bounded at 48 hours

writer-agent.check: gates owns-paths and validate: the changed files are inside owns_paths and expected_outputs exist with content

verification.check: every verification[].command exits 0 in the sandbox (gate verification passed)

code-critique.reason: a model's review of the candidate
code-critique.form: parseCodeCritique: verdict schema; a critical or high finding counts only when its file is among the candidate's files and its line exists in it

plan-fact.check: blindPlanFact checks each acceptance row of the writer's plan-fact table against the candidate: the cited file is among the changed files, the cited lines overlap a changed hunk, the cited command is a verification[] command that exited 0; the writer's prose is never read

proof.check: spawns the writer session in its worktree and sets the turn silence deadline (at most 3 primary visits)
durable wait on lp.thread.idle bounded by the writer silence threshold deadline
nudges a silent writer up to 2 visits and sets a new silence threshold deadline
stops a silent writer after 2 unanswered nudges and releases its admission slot
inspects finished writer turn output for completion, provider errors/limits, ASK_PM questions, or cancellation

nodes.label: Wait writer answer or owner word

proof.check: durable wait on lp.writer.answered bounded by writer question wait (2h) or owner word (6h) deadline
runs question-rules -> second-pilot -> safe-default -> owner-inbox cascade or blocks expired 6h owner-word wait
routes answered writer question back to wait-turn or owner word decision to merge
every verification[].command and ownership/plan-fact check passes in the sandbox

proof.reason: a model's review of the candidate
proof.form: parseCodeCritique: verdict schema; a critical or high finding counts only when its file is among the candidate's files and its line exists in it

proof.check: persists acceptance-v2 receipt and integrates worktree into base checkout; busy/dirty waits park on deadlines
durable wait on busy or dirty checkout bounded by merge/dirty deadline
condition 1 of stopped: awaits writer process exit event or 30s deadline
condition 2 of stopped: awaits worktree hand-back event or 60s deadline
closes canceled attempt and stages once both process exit and work hand-back completed
closes stopped turn permanently and posts named owner inbox item when process exit or work hand-back timed out
the task is accepted with a passed acceptance receipt and its contract carries qa_cases and qa_url; a task without them, or one that did not end accepted, goes on without a check
the browser-qa stage receipt of the task holds the verdict of the check thread; a failed one leaves the task not done
reruns the task once on the role fallback model in a fresh attempt after 3 primary writer visits fail
writes an open owner inbox item with failureClass when writer retries and fallback rerun both exhaust
the fallback attempt accepted with a passed acceptance receipt and its contract carries qa_cases and qa_url
the browser-qa stage receipt of the fallback attempt holds the verdict of the check thread

edges.label: passed, skipped or failed (the summary decides nothing)
revised: a fresh critic judges it
not revised: to the PM with the findings of every round
held, capped, overlapping or breaker open
3 failed visits -> rerun with role fallback model
retry synchronous failure or provider error
provider error / limit hold -> retry via admission
resolved by rules, second pilot or safe default
